Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Jyhad starters contained 45 Commons, 13 Uncommons, 16 Vampires
(where "vampire" also includes 10 or so political actions that appeared
on the vampire sheet), and 2 Rares.

The 1995 VTES starters contained 3 rares. They also had a special sheet
of "starter" commons that fed into the common slots in addition to the
normal commons, IIRC. Not sure as to the ratios of the commons,
uncommons, and vampires, however.
